goal: alert me when the purchase tag stops firing
summary: Alerts watch a number on a report widget, so the audit needs at least one completed run first. We'll open its report, find the widget showing "the purchase tag stops firing", and create the alert from its bell — that pre-fills the metric and filters. Notifications go to your account email.
